title: Design System: TR Tools (Planner and Race The Coco, Hub)

display.purpose: Header percentage (2.75rem). Race The Coco: countdown number (clamp 4.5-6rem), podium numerals (2.4rem).

headline.purpose: Page title (1.9rem) and month label (1.75rem). Race The Coco: page title 1.9rem, results title 2rem.

title.purpose: Notes panel title (1.25rem) and sticky note title (1.15rem).

body.purpose: Notes, to-dos, popover options, day note previews.

label.purpose: Toolbar group titles, weekday header, panel field labels; uppercase at 800 weight.

hub-display.purpose: The "TR Tools" brand, Special Elite, clamp 2.6-4.5rem.

hub-headline.purpose: Tool name on the folder, clamp 2-3.1rem.

hub-body.purpose: Tool description in system sans, 1.3rem, max 30ch.

shadows.name: floating-layer
shadows.purpose: Day popover and clear confirm; toast uses 0.25 opacity.

shadows.name: sticky-lift
shadows.value: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)) drop-shadow(0 12px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)) drop-shadow(0 28px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.35))
shadows.purpose: Sticky note dialog; filter used because clip-path cuts box-shadow.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default control: requirement, paint tools, import holidays. Active fills green.
components.css: .ds-btn { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border: 2px solid var(--green, #1d4b34); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper, #fafaf5); color: var(--green, #1d4b34); font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn:hover:not(.ds-active) { background: var(--paper-2, #eee9da); } .ds-btn.ds-active { background: var(--green, #1d4b34); color: #fff; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #d64000); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Solid Button
components.css: .ds-solid { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border: 2px solid var(--green, #1d4b34); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--green, #1d4b34); color: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-solid:hover { background: #163a29; } .ds-solid:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #d64000); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action such as Clear month.
components.css: .ds-danger { padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; border: 2px solid #9c2b1b; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper, #fafaf5); color: #9c2b1b; font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-danger:hover { background: #fbe9e5; } .ds-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #d64000); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: To-do and notes fields: white fill, 2px green border, orange focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 2px solid var(--green, #1d4b34); border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #14281e); font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.45; padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; caret-color: #d64000; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4d5a52; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 3px solid #d64000; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Stickers
components.description: Solid status tags on day cells; Remote is the tinted exception with an inset outline.
components.html: In Office Remote OOO Holiday
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 3px; margin-right: 0.35rem; } .ds-in { background: #1d4b34; color: #fff; } .ds-remote { background: #d3ebe6; color: #14574d; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #14574d; } .ds-ooo { background: #6d4c9f; color: #fff; } .ds-hol { background: #d64000; color: #fff; }

components.name: Day Cell
components.description: Ruled calendar cell with round date number; today gets the orange wash and disc.

components.css: .ds-cell { width: 140px; min-height: 132px; box-sizing: border-box; border-right: 3px solid #1d4b34; border-bottom: 3px solid #1d4b34; border-top: 3px solid #1d4b34; background: #fafaf5; color: #14281e; padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-cell:hover { background: #eee9da; } .ds-num { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; min-width: 1.9rem; height: 1.9rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-today { background: #fff1e6; } .ds-today .ds-num { background: #d64000; color: #fff; } .ds-tag { background: #1d4b34; color: #fff; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Race The Coco Pixel Sprite
components.description: Race The Coco: 16x24 part-code pixel character, soft-shaded (right edge of each part 26% darker) with a 1px #1b1b1b outline, drawn at whole-number scale (4px in race). Shown as a 2x grid of palette cells.
components.css: .ds-sprite { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; width: 32px; border: 1px solid #1b1b1b; image-rendering: pixelated; } .ds-sprite i { display: block; height: 9px; } .ds-sprite .h { background: #e8c64a; } .ds-sprite .s { background: #f2cfb3; } .ds-sprite .t { background: #262626; } .ds-sprite .p { background: #7b8088; } .ds-sprite .o { background: #f6f6f6; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 #1b1b1b; }

components.name: Race The Coco Lanes
components.description: Race The Coco: 116px ruled paper lanes with 3px green rules, a checkered finish and scaled surge wind lines clipped to the track. Setup shows an 84px-lane preview of every racer.
components.css: .ds-track { position: relative; width: 300px; border: 3px solid #1d4b34; } .ds-lane { height: 60px; background: #fafaf5; border-bottom: 3px solid #1d4b34; position: relative; } .ds-lane.ds-alt { background: #eee9da; border-bottom: 0; } .ds-wind { position: absolute; left: 60px; top: 22px; width: 24px; height: 3px; background: #1d4b3499; } .ds-wind.ds-super { top: 34px; width: 38px; background: #d64000cc; } .ds-finish { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 24px; background: repeating-conic-gradient(#14281e 0 25%, #fff 0 50%) 0 0 / 12px 12px; }

components.name: Race The Coco Countdown
components.description: Race The Coco: Archivo Black number in green on Shadow Paper, no caption, racers shown under the number; GO is orange.
components.css: .ds-count { display: flex; gap: 2rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2rem; border: 3px solid #1d4b34; background: #eee9da; } .ds-count span { font-family: 'Archivo Black', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 4.5rem; line-height: 1; color: #1d4b34; } .ds-count .ds-go { color: #d64000; }

components.name: Sticky Note
components.description: Day note editor: tilted peach note with tape, ruled lines and a folded corner.
components.css: .ds-sticky { position: relative; width: 260px; padding: 2.1rem 1.5rem 1.25rem; background: linear-gradient(172deg, #ffc99d 0%, #ffb27a 100%); color: #2b1608; transform: rotate(-1.6deg); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 30px), calc(100% - 30px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-sticky h2 { font-family: 'Archivo Black', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 0 0 0.7rem; } .ds-sticky p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.7rem; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(transparent 0, transparent calc(1.7rem - 1px), rgba(43,22,8,0.28) calc(1.7rem - 1px), rgba(43,22,8,0.28) 1.7rem); } .ds-tape { position: absolute; top: -0.2rem; left: 50%; width: 96px; height: 26px; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(2deg); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

components.name: Hub Tabs
components.description: Hub: manila folder tabs; the selected tab is taller and paper-colored, opening into the folder.
components.css: .ds-hub-tabs { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 6px; padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 0; background: #cdbf9f; } .ds-hub-tab { height: 2.6rem; padding: 0 1.4rem; background: #d9b96a; color: #2b2b2b; border: 3px solid #2b2b2b; border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0; font-family: "Special Elite", "Courier New", monospace; font-size: 1.1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-hub-tab:hover { background: #e5c97f; } .ds-hub-sel { height: 3.2rem; background: #fbf6e9; border-bottom-color: #fbf6e9; } .ds-hub-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2b2b2b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hub Open Stamp
components.description: Hub: the only red element; outlined rubber stamp that fills on hover and presses down on click.
components.html: Open
components.css: .ds-hub-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.6rem; border: 4px solid #b5342a; color: #b5342a; font-family: "Special Elite", "Courier New", monospace; font-size: 1.5rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration: none; transform: rotate(-3deg); transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-hub-stamp:hover { background: #b5342a; color: #fbf6e9; } .ds-hub-stamp:active { transform: rotate(-3deg) translateY(3px) scale(0.97); } .ds-hub-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2b2b2b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-hub-folder { position: relative; isolation: isolate; margin: 24px 8px 0; padding: 2rem; min-height: 140px; background: #fbf6e9; border: 3px solid #2b2b2b; border-radius: 6px; color: #2b2b2b; } .ds-hub-folder::before, .ds-hub-folder::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border: 3px solid #2b2b2b; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-hub-folder::before { background: #f1e7cc; transform: translateY(-9px); } .ds-hub-folder::after { background: #d9b96a; transform: translateY(-18px); } .ds-hub-folder h2 { margin: 0; font-family: "Special Elite", "Courier New", monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-hub-folder p { margin: 0.6rem 0 0; font-size: 1.1rem; max-width: 30ch; }

narrative.overview:
A printed month planner pinned to a cubicle wall, with a pen beside it. Warm paper, a heavy forest-green ruled grid, solid color stickers for status. It answers "am I on track?" at a glance and lets you mark days the way you would mark paper.

It is square-cornered, ruled and flat. Color is information: each status is a solid sticker, and a single orange accent marks what is live (today, the active holiday tool, selection, focus, notes). The one soft, tactile moment is the sticky note editor, which is a real object lying on the wall.

The build refuses the soft rounded SaaS calendar: pale pastel cells, gray hairline grids, generous radii.
keyCharacteristics: Heavy 3px green rules draw the grid, panel and popover edges; corners are 3px at most.
Solid status stickers, never tinted cells; Remote is the only tinted tag and carries an inset outline.
Archivo Black for numerals and titles, system sans at 700-800 for everything else, tabular numerals throughout.
One accent (orange) used sparingly; green is structure and ink.
Flat at rest; lift appears only on floating layers (popover, toast, sticky note).
Race The Coco extension: the same paper, green rules and single orange, now holding a race; 16x24 shaded, outlined pixel sprites drawn at 4px per pixel are the only color on the track.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange marks what is live or noted. It is never decoration and never a second brand color.

rules.name: The Solid Sticker Rule
rules.body: Status is a solid fill with white text; the only exception is Remote's tinted teal with an inset outline. No pastel cell washes.

rules.name: The Status Palette Rule
rules.body: In Office green, Remote teal, OOO plum, Holiday orange are fixed, identical across legend dots, paint tools and day stickers.

rules.name: The Block Numerals Rule
rules.body: Large figures (percentage, month, title) use the display face; everything else stays in system sans.

rules.name: The Flat-On-The-Wall Rule
rules.body: Cells, panels, buttons and badges carry no shadow. Only layers that float above the wall do.

rules.name: The Sprites Are The Colour Rule
rules.body: On the race screens the sprites and the winner's orange step are the only color beyond paper, green and ink.

dos: Do build structure with 3px green rules and 2px green control borders.
Do show status as a solid sticker with white text, in the fixed four-status palette.
Do reserve orange for what is live: today, selection, focus, notes, Holiday.
Do set big numbers in Archivo Black and keep tabular numerals on.
Do keep a 3px orange focus outline on every interactive element.
Do (Race The Coco) draw sprites at whole-number scale, pixelated, with the 1px `#1b1b1b` outline, and add characters as new part-code palettes.
Do (Race The Coco) use orange for the winner step, GO and super-surge lines, green for normal surge and all other steps.
donts: Don't use pastel cell fills or gray hairline grids; this world rejects the soft SaaS calendar.
Don't round beyond 3px (the date disc and the sticky note are the only exceptions).
Don't add shadows to anything resting on the wall; shadow is for floating layers.
Don't introduce a second accent or new status colors.
Don't extend this look to the hub; the hub has its own character (Part 2). Race The Coco is the one sanctioned extension.
Don't reskin Race The Coco as a video game; sprites on ruled paper, no neon, scanlines or arcade chrome.
Don't key a sprite or behaviour to a typed racer name.

hub.overview:
The hub is a drawer of manila folders, one per tool. It refuses the equal grid of icon cards: the tool you pick is pulled forward at full size, with its name, one-line description, a drawn miniature and a red OPEN stamp. A desk-kraft ground, cream folder paper, heavy ink outlines and typewriter lettering give it a bold identity of its own, separate from the tools it opens.

Depth is made only of overlapping sheets: two more folders peek above the front one, and choosing a tab slides that folder forward. Red appears once, on the Open stamp, and nowhere else.
keyCharacteristics: Desk kraft ground, manila tabs, cream paper, ink outlines at a uniform 3px.
Special Elite typewriter face for brand, tabs, tool names and the stamp; system sans for body prose.
One red (Stamp Red), reserved for the Open action.
Flat paper, no blur or glow; stacking is the only depth.
Tabs flow and wrap, so 3 to 6 tools fit at any width.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamp Red is used on the Open action only. Never for status, errors, links or decoration.

rules.name: The Typewriter Label Rule
rules.body: Typewriter face for what names or triggers a thing; system sans for what explains it.

rules.name: The Stacked Sheets Rule
rules.body: Depth comes only from overlapping outlined sheets. No box-shadow, blur or glow on the hub.

dos: Do draw every edge with the 3px ink line and keep corners at 3 to 6px (tabs 14px on top only).
Do use Stamp Red solely for the Open action.
Do set brand, tabs, tool names and the stamp in Special Elite; body prose in system sans.
Do add a new tool as another tab, folder panel and drawn miniature; let tabs wrap.
Do build depth only by stacking outlined sheets.
Do keep a depicted app's colors and fonts inside its miniature; hub chrome stays on hub tokens.
donts: Don't replace the drawer with an equal grid of icon cards.
Don't add shadows, gradients or glow to the hub.
Don't use red for anything but Open, or introduce a second accent.
Don't use screenshots or live embeds as previews; draw miniatures (HTML/CSS or canvas with the tool's real assets).
Don't carry the Planner's green grid or orange accent into hub chrome.
